products.title: Fresh Minted Bills (Al)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The aluminum ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in green, mint green, and black.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Aluminum.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

The melting point of Aluminum is 1220 degrees F or 660 degrees C.   A propane torch is capable of reaching these temps so if you use a torch to remove ferrules and shafts don’t apply the torch for an excessively long duration.  We recommend a heat gun instead,   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

products.title: Bleeding Edge (Ti)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The titanic, ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point. So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Titanium.  
-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 
-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).
-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.

-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.   For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point.  So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.

-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.

-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.
-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.
-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

-Will they melt?

No.  The melting point of Titanium is over 3000 degrees F or 1660 degrees C.   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.

-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

Designed for .355" taper tipped steel shafts. They'll work with .370" tip shafts and graphite irons shafts with steeper taper profiles as well, but will need to be reamed out slightly before installation.  If a ferrule is too snug to slide up a shaft to where it needs to sit, do not ram it up the shaft with brute force.  Ream out the inner diameter until it fits.

Installation instructions:

These 3d printed ferrules install similarly to traditional ferrules with one key exception: we advise against using force to slide the ferrule up the shaft for any 3d printed design that has vertical seams between colors.  3d printed ferrules with intricate designs are a bit more delicate where 2 colors meet and form a vertical seam.  Using force to push a ferrule that is too snug higher up a shaft can cause cracking or splitting at the seam.  Instead, if a ferrule is too snug for your shaft, we recommend widening the inner diameter of the ferrule with a cylindrical file, a drill, or sandpaper until it can slide up to where it will sit above the hosel.

products.title: Black LE Phunt (Al)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The aluminum ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Aluminum.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

The melting point of Aluminum is 1220 degrees F or 660 degrees C.   A propane torch is capable of reaching these temps so if you use a torch to remove ferrules and shafts don’t apply the torch for an excessively long duration.  We recommend a heat gun instead,   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

products.title: Red & Gold Fei Long (Ti)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The titanic, ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point. So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Titanium.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.   For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point.  So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

No.  The melting point of Titanium is over 3000 degrees F or 1660 degrees C.   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

products.title: Offshore Account (Ti)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The titanic, ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point. So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Titanium.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.   For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point.  So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

No.  The melting point of Titanium is over 3000 degrees F or 1660 degrees C.   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.   For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point.  So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

No.  The melting point of Titanium is over 3000 degrees F or 1660 degrees C.   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

products.title: Purple Fauxkume (Al)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The aluminum ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Aluminum.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

The melting point of Aluminum is 1220 degrees F or 660 degrees C.   A propane torch is capable of reaching these temps so if you use a torch to remove ferrules and shafts don’t apply the torch for an excessively long duration.  We recommend a heat gun instead,   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The aluminum ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Aluminum.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

The melting point of Aluminum is 1220 degrees F or 660 degrees C.   A propane torch is capable of reaching these temps so if you use a torch to remove ferrules and shafts don’t apply the torch for an excessively long duration.  We recommend a heat gun instead,   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The aluminum ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Aluminum.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

The melting point of Aluminum is 1220 degrees F or 660 degrees C.   A propane torch is capable of reaching these temps so if you use a torch to remove ferrules and shafts don’t apply the torch for an excessively long duration.  We recommend a heat gun instead,   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

products.title: Montecarlo (Ti)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The titanic, ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point. So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Titanium.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.   For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point.  So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

No.  The melting point of Titanium is over 3000 degrees F or 1660 degrees C.   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

products.title: Dot the i (Ti)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The titanic, ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point. So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Titanium.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” titanium ferrule weighs about 3.1g.  The optional plastic base ring weighs about 0.5g.   For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  Approximately 2g of head weight equates to 1 swingweight point.  So these ferrules will add less than 1 swingweight point compared to a standard BB&F plastic ferrule.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

No.  The melting point of Titanium is over 3000 degrees F or 1660 degrees C.   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.

products.title: Mud Flaps (Al)
products.body_html:
NOTE: all metal ferrules and ferruled accessories are currently shipping in 10-15 business days (4/2/26).

Sold as Individual pieces.  I.e. the price shown is for 1 ferrule + base ring, not a set of 10.

The aluminum ferrule is 1" tall and can be installed with or without a 0.1" or 0.3" plastic base ring.

Base rings are sized to fit either .370" or .355" shafts.  OD of the metal ferrule is ~.540" if installed without a visible base ring.  OD is ~.550" with a visible base ring.

Base rings are available for this design in a variety of colors.  The rings fit into the base of the ferrules and can be turned down upon installation to make the ferrule sit perfectly flush on the hosel like a traditional plastic ferrule.  If used without a visible base ring the quality of fit depends on the diameter of the hosel of your irons.  

These ferrules can be removed and reinstalled (other than the base ring, that'll be deader than fried chicken after removal). If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it during removal with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers. We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.

 

FAQ's:

What are these made of?

Aluminum.  


-Are they 3d printed?

No.  They are CNC machined. 


-What’s that ring at the bottom?

These ferrules can be installed with or without a base ring.   The base ring is made of plastic and can be turned down like a traditional plastic ferrule so the ferrule sits perfectly flush with the hosel of the club.  A metal ferrule installed without a base ring cannot be turned down (unless you have serious metalworking skills) but they are designed to match the diameter of most club hosels (0.54”).


-Do I need to buy 10 at a time?

No.  You can buy as few as 1 ferrule of any design and mix and match your order however you see fit.


-How much do they weigh?   Will they change the swing weight of my clubs?

The 1” aluminum ferrule plus base or spacer ring weighs in the range of 2.3g to 2.7g depending on which style of base ring you choose.  For comparison purposes, a standard (1.3”) plastic BB&F ferrule weights about 2.3g.  So these ferrules will not have an inordinate impact on your clubs' swingweights.


-How do you install them?

The same way you install plastic ferrules - with epoxy when you install the shaft into the club head.


-Will they fit .370” shafts?

They should.  We haven’t tested them on every shaft model in existence but we have tested them on quite a few and they fit every shaft we’ve tried except 1.  If they are too small for your shafts please contact us to let us know.  We can give you some tips on how to get them to fit.


-Will they fit hybrids or fairway woods?

No.


-How do you remove them?

The same way you remove a shaft from a club head - heat it until the epoxy bond breaks and then pull it off.  If you plan to reuse the ferrule, make sure to not grab it with something that will mar or scratch the aluminum like pliers.  We recommend a heat gun and heavy duty heat resistant work gloves.


-Will they melt?

The melting point of Aluminum is 1220 degrees F or 660 degrees C.   A propane torch is capable of reaching these temps so if you use a torch to remove ferrules and shafts don’t apply the torch for an excessively long duration.  We recommend a heat gun instead,   The base rings are plastic and will melt just like any plastic ferrule.


-Can they be reused?

Yes!   The base rings cannot but we sell extra / replacement base rings.
